spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the exact WGSL 64-bit integer layout rule for atomic<vec2u>: the 64-bit unsigned value is (u64(v.y) << 32) | u64(v.x), making .y the most-significant 32-bit word and .x the least-significant 32-bit word.

interactive.rationale: Users can toggle between spec-compliant vec2u(payload, depthKey) and buggy vec2u(depthKey, payload), drag depth and payload ID sliders, trigger an equal-depth tie-breaker preset, and inspect the 64-bit register diagram.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index description of a 64-bit vec2u bit-layout inspector demonstrating why .y is the MSB sort key and .x is the LSB payload.

edge_cases.rationale: Explicitly demonstrates both the swapped-component failure mode (where payload ID corrupts depth sorting) and deterministic equal-depth tie-breaking.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/4882016087703552, the W3C WebGPU specification, and WGSL issue #5071.

conformance.rationale: Probes adapter.features.has('atomic-vec2u-min-max') and validates 64-bit unsigned integer comparison semantics.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified packing mode selector, sliders, tie-breaker button, and SVG register diagram updates with zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry assertion for the WebGPU adapter probe and updates live comparison telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Uses only CSS custom properties from /public/styles.css with zero raw hex or rgba colors.

accessibility.rationale: SVG register diagram has role=img and aria-label, all sliders and selects have explicit labels and 44px height, and hazard warnings update in aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive grid and viewBox-scaled SVG register diagram render cleanly without horizontal overflow on 360px mobile and 1280px desktop screens.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure visual diagrams have synchronized DOM text tables and live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Paired the 64-bit SVG register diagram with a 5-column hex/decimal table and aria-live readout.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide single-click keyboard-accessible preset buttons for boundary states.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added a 44px Equal-Depth Tie-Breaker preset button.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give inline SVGs role=img and descriptive aria-labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied role=img and aria-label on the 64-bit register diagram SVG.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap every input and select control in an accessible label with min-height: 44px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All 5 controls are wrapped in semantic <label class='ctrl-card'> containers with min-height: 44px.

summary: Interactive 64-bit vec2u endian & word-order inspector explaining why .y must hold the 32-bit sort key and .x the 32-bit payload in atomic<vec2u>.
